title: Headless Beyond the Beef failed (VMS18 255): Ted Gunderson killed with objective 10 never shown (Marjorie dead before Heck's request) and Mortimer's offer not taken

actions.text: Path: Ted Gunderson, held beneath the Gourmand, dies before the player has heard of his disappearance (objective 10 not shown, Mortimer's offer not taken); his OnDeath block (VMS18TedGundersonSCRIPT) sets VMS18 255 (Fail Quest). Stand-ins: travel by move_player (the Gourmand's locked rooms are not walked); the fight by kill.

Ted's OnDeath (VMS18TedGundersonSCRIPT) sets 255 when objective 10 is not shown, Mortimer's offer is not taken and the quest is not done. Ted is placed disabled (VMS18TedGundersonREF, Initially Disabled) and only VMS18 lines enable him: Heck's request (INFO 0x0010FB10) and Mortimer's two offers (0x00125ACD, 0x00126909). His freezer door (001199D4, level 255) opens only with VMS18TedGundersonKey, which Mortimer's offers and Philippe's 0x00117E36 hand over. So he cannot die before anyone asks after him; the way that keeps objective 10 hidden: Marjorie dies first (0x0010FB10 shows objective 10 only while she lives, and her OnDeath hides it), then Heck asks (Ted and Philippe enabled), Philippe hands over the freezer key, Ted dies.
Stand-in for the walk into the Gourmand and the fight with Marjorie: travel by move_player, the fight by kill.
Stand-in for the walk to Heck Gunderson in the Ultra-Luxe casino: travel by move_player; his request is his line 0x0010FB10.
Stand-in for getting into the Gourmand's back rooms (door 00118AC9, lock level 25) and down to the kitchen: travel by move_player; Philippe hands over the freezer key (his line 0x00117E36).
